items.after:
Add `src/map.js` and teach `src/main.js` to render it:

- `src/map.js`
  - `CellType` enum: `ENTRY`, `PATH`, `SPLIT`, `EXIT`, `EMPTY`, `BUILD_SITE`.
  - `GRID_ROWS`, `GRID_COLS`, `CELL_SIZE` (mirror `../humans`: 15×21, 32px).
  - `generateMap(rows, cols)` — builds a one-cell-wide *directed* path network
    flowing left→right, so acyclicity is guaranteed by construction (every edge
    increases the column index). One `ENTRY` on the left; random splits (a cell
    fans out to 1–3 cells in the next column) and joins (two branches target
    the same cell); rightmost path cells become `EXIT`. Returns
    `{ grid, next, entries, exits }` where `next[r][c]` lists each path cell's
    directed `[nr, nc]` targets.
  - `verifyMap(map)` — runs the four invariants (every entry reaches an exit;
    every path cell reachable from an entry; every path cell reaches an exit;
    acyclic) and returns a boolean.
- `src/main.js` — render each cell with a color per type, and draw a short line
  from each path cell's center toward each of its `next` cells so direction
  (and splits) are visible. Entry and exit use distinct colors.

Not in this step (deferred per the roadmap): build-site placement (item 6),
`src/config.js` (no tunable values yet), traveler movement (item 3).

*Done when:* every generated map passes `verifyMap` and the browser shows the
directed path with direction visible.
